digest.component_or_area: Makefile typecheck target and mypy configuration
propositions: The typecheck target runs mypy only over src/rebar, leaving 47 .py files in scripts/ lint-clean but type-unchecked, despite scripts/ being invoked by CI gating logic
Widening typecheck to include scripts/ surfaces 15 fixable mypy errors across 6 script files, all correctible at source without blanket ignores or per-module overrides
Two of the 15 errors represent latent bugs: capture_jira_fixtures calling .strip() on str|None, and check_complexity_baseline passing possibly-None dict to lock_against_base due to guard placement
The sys.path bootstraps in 9 script files require no special mypy configuration beyond existing follow_imports=silent and ignore_missing_imports settings
Stale typecheck scope descriptions in .pre-commit-config.yaml and .github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml must be updated to reflect the widened src/rebar+scripts scope
A new guard test must verify scripts/ remains in the typecheck recipe and reject any future narrowing of the scope
